Paragraph: "Aha! You made a monkey of yourself, oh, monkey, and you feel small, thus you are not able to stay firm in your mind by that fickleness, and your monkeyshines is clear by it..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Fickleness and mental instability weakening leadership and self-worth.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Hanuma uses candid, witty feedback to call out Sugreeva's irrational fickleness.
Outcome/Resolution: He shocks Sugreeva out of panic into self-awareness.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Chanchalata (Mind's restlessness and fickleness that needs mastery)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Exposes monkey-mind fickleness (Chanchalata) as an impediment to spiritual poise and dignity.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Benevolent confrontation: using direct, lighthearted candor to highlight cognitive instability and spur self-correction.
